note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified, illustrative-unverified). Relationships, their kinds and the traversal order are supplied by the author; the scene only draws them and never assesses the argument.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional club ledger: premise → claim and claim → premise are supplied as support links, so they form a cycle (ring + loop badge); the external premise supports the claim and rests on the outside support; the rule is a plain relation. The marker goes round the ring back to the premise, then out along the chain to the outside support.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional example (school canteen) whose supplied links contain NO cycle — the premise is supported by the external premise, which rests on the outside support. No ring, no loop badge; the marker climbs from the outside support to the claim and the external premise is the focus part.

params.claim: The new canteen menu is popular
facts: Most pupils chose the new menu last week
Survey S-3: 61 of 90 pupils chose it (hypothetical)
rules: School rule 12 (fictional text): a popular menu stays for one term
issues: Which link leads outside the claim?
assumptions: Survey figures are hypothetical, as supplied
